_comment: ILM policy for the log data streams (logs-docker, logs-traefik, logs-system).
hot   -> rollover at 10 GB or 1 day. Both, because the two failure modes
differ: a burst of errors reaches 10 GB in hours, while a quiet
night would otherwise leave a single index open for weeks.
warm  -> at 7 days, forcemerge to 1 segment. Log data is never updated
after ingestion, so a single segment is optimal for search and
halves the disk footprint. The replica is KEPT: losing a node
delete-> at 90 days, matching the Cassandra TTL so both stores age out
together and a correlation query never finds one side missing.
